article_title: .NET 11 RC1：亮点核对与 API 纠错
core_theme: 把一篇 .NET 11 RC1 亮点文章里的每个特性对着官方发布说明逐条核对，区分真特性与写错的代码示例
reader_takeaway: 知道原文哪些判断成立、哪两段示例编译不过，以及每个特性的正确 API 与官方出处
summary_angle: 一张写满亮点的高光清单被放到官方发布说明的逆光前逐条比对：四块内容亮起确认为真，两小块代码对不上被标出，旁边补上正确写法

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: fact-checking every claim in a .NET 11 RC1 highlights article against the official release notes, separating genuine features from code samples that do not compile. The reader should quickly feel that a claim sheet is being held up against an authoritative reference and that misaligned parts stand out.

Summary angle: a translucent highlight sheet carrying four glowing content blocks is held up in front of one large luminous reference document; backlight passes through both, four blocks line up and shine through as true, two small code cards sit visibly out of alignment and are marked as gaps, and three crisply aligned cards beside them show the corrected form.
Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- problem: a floating highlight sheet with four glowing content blocks representing the four topics the article picked; visible label 四项亮点
- mechanism: the sheet held up against one huge luminous reference document, light shining through from behind, the two layers' line spacing coming into register; visible label 逐条核对
- evidence: two small code cards visibly out of alignment with the reference lines behind them, their edges marked as gaps; visible label 示例有误
- takeaway: three clean, crisply aligned cards beside the misaligned ones, lit by the same backlight; visible label 正确写法

Main metaphor: holding a highlight sheet up to the backlight of the official document - what is real shines through, what is misaligned shows a gap.
Subject: a translucent highlight sheet and the large luminous reference document behind it, as the dominant focal pair.
Composition/framing: left-right comparison, the reference document as the large luminous plane on one side and the held-up sheet as the nearer subject on the other, with the misaligned cards as the tension point between them. One clear focal point in a wide frame.
Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: transparent blue skies, dramatic backlight, detailed clouds, youthful cinematic lighting, rain and reflection details, no artist imitation. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: transparent sky blue, backlit gold-white, cloud grey-blue, raindrop highlight white. Keep the sky and clouds as lighting and depth only; the documents must stay the dominant subject.
Visible text policy: allow only these 4 short Chinese chips, each on one small plate: 四项亮点, 逐条核对, 示例有误, 正确写法. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no code text, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake terminal output.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: human faces or anime characters, English slogans, fake terminal output, fabricated gauges or axes, neon colors, meaningless code rain, floating chips, dense HUD overlays.
